description: This file defines the PHP class 'SubscriptionStatus' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation' namespace. The class provides methods for managing subscription status data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving subscription statuses and their descriptions from a database.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Manages subscription status data, including CRUD operations and fetching localized descriptions.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Insert new subscription statuses for multiple languages based on provided data.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Update a subscription status and its localized descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Remove a subscription status by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Delete all subscription status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific subscription status by its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Fetch a list of subscription statuses, optionally ordered and paginated, for the current language.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Return the total number of subscription statuses for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Get all descriptions of a subscription status across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieve descriptions of subscription statuses filtered by a specific language ID.
